title: isolated-trial (WUI-21 server-side contract)
description:
One isolated trial of a candidate, and the three results the owner's pack insists stay separate.

The pack's rule for WUI-10/WUI-21 is that writing, native load-back and target-behaviour confirmation are
three different answers, and a success in one must not light up the others. A shape with a single `success`
boolean cannot express that, so this contract carries `separated_results` with its own status and basis per
stage, and there is no aggregate verdict field to misread. Where this repository has no producer for a stage,
the stage says UNKNOWN with the reason instead of inheriting the previous stage's answer.

trial_id.description: The trial's own identity, so a lost refresh can re-query the same trial rather than open a new one.

child_task_id.description: The task the trial actually runs. null means no child was attached, which the UI shows as 'no trial exists' rather than as an idle trial.

isolation.description: What makes this run isolated from the live target. Answered only from an execution row; a trial with no row reports basis NONE.

write.description: Result #1: did the candidate get applied to the isolated surface.

native_readback.description: Result #2: did the native tool report the value back. A successful write is not evidence of this; the ledger's REVIEWING state is what carries it.

target_behaviour.description: Result #3: did the target actually behave. Carried only from an external-effect record that was reconciled (EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STATES), because the source succeeding never stands in for the target.

producer_gaps.description: REUSE_OF_SOURCE_RESULT is listed when the only evidence available came from the source evaluation, which is a gap by definition and never a pass for the target.

note.description: Short, and only what the named basis actually observed. A basis of NO_PRODUCER must not carry a reassuring sentence.
